name: third-party-onboarding-manager
description: Third-party onboarding monorepo with NestJS API and reusable packages

scripts.database:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env stop third-party-onboarding-manager-database && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env rm -f third-party-onboarding-manager-database
scripts.database:destroy: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env stop third-party-onboarding-manager-database && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env rm -f third-party-onboarding-manager-database -v

scripts.command-publisher:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env stop third-party-onboarding-manager-command-publisher && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env rm -f third-party-onboarding-manager-command-publisher
